local_patches.why: COAir runs the toolkit on its own Google billing. Makes Gemini the managed provider (MANAGED_PROVIDER in dcma/narrative.py) defaulting to gemini-flash-latest, removes the NVIDIA provider COAir holds no key for, and adds a COAIR_URL-gated 'Back to COAir' link. Upstream ships NVIDIA as the managed default and has no link back.
